description: This file defines the 'ModelMenuCondition' class, which models the '<condition>' element within a widget menu system in the OFBiz framework. It encapsulates condition logic and styling attributes for menu items, meant to be a read-only and thread-safe representation of XML configuration.

classes.name: ModelMenuCondition
classes.description: Represents a read-only, immutable model of a menu condition element loaded from XML, containing condition logic and style expanders.

methods.name: ModelMenuCondition
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the menu condition model from an XML element and related menu item, setting up style expanders and condition logic.

methods.name: getCondition
methods.description: Returns the ModelCondition instance representing the condition logic.

methods.name: getFailStyleExdr
methods.description: Returns the FlexibleStringExpander for the fail/disabled style.

methods.name: getPassStyleExdr
methods.description: Returns the FlexibleStringExpander for the pass style.
